It was rotated and now lives only in the GitHub Actions secret NTFY_TOPIC_US, read at runtime by scripts/OutboxLib.ps1. Never put a topic back in this file.
live_notes: live.strategy selects the rule Get-Signals.ps1 actually trades. 'rsi_revert' is RSI(2) mean reversion on DAILY bars: buy when RSI closes below rsi_buy_below, sell when it closes above rsi_exit_above. It is the only configuration tested in this project that beat a matched random control after correcting for multiple testing (p=0.03, US large caps 2000-2013). Set live.strategy to 'ema_cross' to restore the previous EMA9/21 behaviour, which uses the top-level interval/range/ema_fast/ema_slow values instead. market_timezone + market_close_local say when the US session ends on New York's own clock (16:00 ET), so the close is 20:00 UTC in summer and 21:00 UTC in winter with no table to maintain; close_settle_minutes waits that long past the bell for the official closing price. Until then the day's still-forming bar is discarded so the rule only ever acts on closed bars. WARNINGS: the same rule measured on 5m bars for this exact watchlist came out WORSE THAN RANDOM and loss-making even at zero cost, and on Tadawul it ranked 14th of 15 with NEGATIVE per-trade expectancy -- which is why the Saudi tracker deliberately still runs ema_cross. Do not copy this block into config-sa.json.

notes: purification_pct is the fraction of each realized profit set aside (0.1 = 10%). Edit any value here and commit/push; the next scheduled run picks it up automatically. sar_per_usd uses SAR's fixed peg to the dollar. ntfy_topic is reused from the PC version so your existing phone subscription keeps working without resubscribing.

notifications.note: When the phone may ring. BUY/SELL alerts go out WHILE THE MARKET IS OPEN, about 30 minutes before the close (22:30 Riyadh in summer, 23:30 in winter): a dispatch at 15:28 New York runs Get-Signals.ps1 inside the pre-close window (preclose_window_minutes before the close), which previews the decision on the current price and pushes it without trading. The paper account still trades only on the real close, in the post-close run at 16:15 New York; that run pushes a trade only if the pre-close alert did not predict it, and the daily summary follows right after and lists any alert that did not happen. Delivery window 07:00 -> 01:30 Riyadh (crosses midnight); anything produced between 01:30 and 07:00 - i.e. GitHub's late backup cron - is held by ntfy via its 'At' header until deliver_from_local. Riyadh is UTC+3 year round, so the fixed offset is exact.
